name: Wall & Shear
description: Engineered for swift cycle repetitions. Integrates ULMA modular wall panels with locally fabricated high-load alignment struts to hold lateral pressure up to 80 kN/m².

name: Column & Pier
description: Custom-rolled high-tensile steel half-cylinders and universal clamp assemblies for fair-faced columns up to 100 kN/m² pour speeds.

name: Circular & Curved
description: Continuously adjustable radius wall formwork engineered for wastewater treatment digesters and cylindrical water storage tanks.

name: Slab & Shoring
description: Aluminum drop-head modular decking enabling 3-day striking cycles while leaving shoring props untouched, reducing inventory on-site by 40%.

name: High-Rise Climbing
description: Crane-free self-climbing hydraulic system carrying multi-tiered placing booms, formwork panels, and weather shields up skyscraper towers.

name: Bridge & Viaduct
description: Specialized modular trusses for balanced cantilever bridges, composite decks, and high-clearance overpass flyovers.
